steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Please come in, Chief.
Garofano pushes open the long-locked door of her shop and leads you inside.
She flips a switch, and a warm yellow light illuminates the room's furnishings. Even though a thin layer of dust has accumulated, you can still feel how cozy and dainty the shop originally was.
You... made all this?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Yes, they're all still works in progress.
She gently caresses a half-made dress on a mannequin and sighs.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Unfortunately, the person who ordered it will never have the chance to wear it.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I haven't been back for so long that even the carnations in the shop have wilted...
That's okay, you can replace them with fresh flowers at the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...That's true. I can redecorate my room to my liking.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I'll go pack some things from the storage room. Feel free to look around.
Garofano goes off to collect her things. You wander between the row of mannequins, curiously observing the unfinished garments.
Boom—
With a thunderous explosion, the front door of the tailor shop is suddenly blown open.
Several masked thugs with Mania weapons barge in, followed by a man with the air of a boss.

steps.speaker: Thug
steps.content: Are you sure it's here, Mr. Braun?

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: Yeah, it's this shop! Hmph, I just saw those two go in... find them quickly!
You immediately realize why the younger Braun brother, who had been on the run, came to this place. He had been waiting for an opportunity to retaliate against those who ruined his plan...
It's easy to buy information from sketchy places. The itinerary of a Bureau Chief should not be hard to get.
As you hide amidst the mannequins, you try to think of a way to escape with Garofano.
Suddenly, a pair of soft, cold hands reach around from behind you. They brush past your neck and cheeks to cover your mouth.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Shh... Chief, it's me.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: The shop has a back door. We can escape from there... come with me.
Garofano gestures in a certain direction. Her voice is very calm, as if she's undisturbed by the sudden attack.
You have no idea how she got so close to you. A strange feeling crosses your mind, but there's no time to think. All you can do is nod.
Crouching down, the two of you dodge the thugs as you move slowly between the numerous clothing racks.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: This is the place... Ah!
A bullet hits Garofano's skirt. You've been discovered.

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: Garofano, you treacherous hag! A sneaky one, aren't you? You always manage to trick others to do your bidding!

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Mr. Braun, I think there's a misunderstanding...

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: A misunderstanding? If it weren't for that bastard next to you, I would have successfully inherited the fortune by now! Yet now I'm a fugitive!

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: This is all your fault!
You can't blame anyone else. When you poisoned your elder brother and framed someone else for the crime, you should have expected these consequences.

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: I don't want to talk to you! I'll show you... Go, capture those two and bring them to me! I want them alive!
The younger Braun brother waves his hand brashly and the thugs charge at you.
Watch out!!
You push Garofano out the door. A stray bullet grazes your arm, immediately drawing blood.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You got injured?!
I... I'm fine. We need to get out of here quickly!
Gritting your teeth, you grab Garofano's slender wrist with your uninjured hand and flee frantically through the alleyways.
The footsteps behind become more and more distant until they can no longer be heard. Only then do you relax, panting and leaning against the wall to sit down.
Okay, we should be safe for now... Those guys had Mania weapons, so they're tough to deal with. We'd better lay low.
Garofano kneels beside you, looking worriedly at your bleeding arm.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Let me take a look at your wound, Chief.
She carefully peels the sticky shirt away from the wound. You can't help but gasp as the pain returns to your numb wound.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...Does it hurt?
...It's bearable.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I'm sorry, it's all my fault...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I'm sorry that you had to shed so much blood for me.
It's not your fault. After all, no one could have expected that the younger Mr. Braun would go crazy like that.
She still looks downcast, so you shake your ragged sleeve and pretend to be distressed.
It's just a pity that the button you sewed on for me fell off.
If you really want to make it up to me... then how about you make a new shirt for me.
Garofano's gaze flickers for a moment, then quickly becomes opaque.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...Sure. I will make you a comfortable tailored shirt.
She unties her hairband, letting her long curls tumble freely.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Please bear with me. Let me bandage you up first.
She gently wipes the blood near the wound, then places the hairband over it. The cold touch seeps into your skin, causing you to shiver.
Hmm... You're quite skilled at this. I hardly felt any pain at all.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Really?
She finishes up by tying a neat knot with her hairband, then looks up at you with a smile.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: That's good. I won't let you... get hurt anymore.
You hear the thugs' footsteps again, and try to prop yourself up to stand.
Garofano, I'm leaving my comms device with you. Contact the FAC for backup. I'll go and distract them...
Before you finish your sentence, you feel a pricking sensation in your arm. Then, numbness swiftly spreads from your arm to your entire body, paralyzing you.
Your vision begins to blur. You lose your balance and fall backward, landing in a soft, warm embrace.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: There, there, don't be scared. This is all normal.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You'll be fine. I just wanted you to be quiet for a bit.
You get hoisted up, your cheek buried in Garofano's long, silky hair. Her unique fragrance fills your nose.
Garofano... why... why did you...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: It's a long-standing hunting habit.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I always choose to strike when my prey least expects it, when they trust and love me the most.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: That would have been... right now. But I don't plan on doing that anymore.
Her tone remains calm and gentle, but it sends a chill down your spine.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: At first, my goal was to eliminate you. After all, the MBCC is a place that imprisons Sinners, and I... detest that.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: But I didn't expect... you to be such a person. You are so upright, passionate, and even naive enough to genuinely care for Sinners.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You are truly amazing... so I willingly let my guard down.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You are still my target. It's just that I want to possess you in a different way.
What... exactly do you want to do?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Didn't I tell you? I won't let you get hurt anymore.
She walks into the depths of the narrow alley, finds the most hidden corner, and gently puts you down. Then, she tears off your blood-soaked sleeve.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: As my possession, all you need to do is stay here and leave everything to me.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: After everything is over, I will take you home.
You lie in the shadows, watching helplessly as Garofano leaves the alley.

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: Well well, look who walked right into their own demise? Where's your friend? Did you get ditched?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Walk into their own demise... ha...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Those words... should be for you.

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: What nonsense are you spewing... Forget it, doesn't matter! Go, get her!
However, after a brief silence, a few heavy thuds echo across the ground. Someone croaks in a weak, trembling voice...

steps.speaker: Thug
steps.content: That power... those skills... and that flower...

steps.speaker: Thug
steps.content: You, you're... from the Garden!

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Correct. Good eye.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: What a pity... Why did you choose to get on my bad side?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Anyone who tries to take away my treasures... must pay the price.
The younger Mr. Braun screams in terror.

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: What... what have you done?!

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I simply taught some delusional fools a lesson. Don't worry, it's your turn next.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I underestimated you, Mr. Braun. I didn't expect such a minor pawn to cause me so much trouble. You even managed to threaten my people.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You and your brother were both my targets. Since I got you to finish off Mr. Braun already, it's time for me to finish you off.

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: "Got me to finish off"... What do you mean by that?

steps.speaker: Younger Mr. Braun
steps.content: Were you the one who leaked the news about splitting assets?! And that poison... did you...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: It seems you're not as foolish as I thought.
The alley falls into complete silence.
At that moment, you feel sensation returning to your limbs. You realize she was being honest when she said she did not intend to harm you.
You slowly stand up, instinctively gripping your arm. You feel something smooth... it's the hairband Garofano used to bandage you.
So she's from the "Garden"...
I will find out... what else you're hiding from me.
The moment you step out of the alley, you're hit by the overpowering stench of blood. The hellish scene in front of you shocks you.
Whoosh! A silver light grazes your cheek and pierces into the wall behind you. You look in the direction the needle flew from and see Garofano, exuding the air of a femme fatale.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Ah... as expected of you, Chief. You've recovered quite quickly.
Seeing that it's you, the coldness of her smile instantly melts like snow.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: See, I've eliminated all the dangerous elements that want to harm you...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Now, no one can take you away from me. You're completely safe... are you happy?
You've been deceiving me this whole time.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Deceiving? No... everything I said was the truth, Chief. All those things really happened.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: It's just that... other than being a member of the Garden, everything has been a mask...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: And if a mask is so perfect that even I'm willing to believe in it... It will become the truth.
Then the one I trusted was the mask, not the Garofano of the Garden standing before me now.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...Do you still remember? Back at the Bureau, you said you'd be my family, and I agreed.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: And I did indeed protect you from those villains.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: So why... why won't you trust me now?
She wears a hurt expression. Those melancholy eyes used to tug at your heartstrings, but you don't dare to trust her anymore.
Masks, deception, and a fabricated past... Is this your way of protecting me?
At the very least, I won't trust an armed assassin that easily.
A smile suddenly flashes across her face.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I see... You're wary of me now.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Then, I'll revert back to the Garofano you're familiar with.
She puts away her needles, tidies herself up, and transforms back to the Garofano you're familiar with.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: There. I'm unarmed now, Chief.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I'm at your mercy, and I won't resist. You can take any measures against me as long as it makes you feel safe.
...You must come back to the Bureau with me.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Sure.
Her attitude is composed and calm. Her voice even carries a hint of indulgence.
Amidst the red light, you capture this elusive woman once again. But you also realize... she's the one setting the pace.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Chief... Chief! Hey, I'm talking to you!
...What is it?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Do you have a moment? Can you bring these to Garofano?
Grinning, she shoves a bundle of old clothes into your arms.
Wait. Can't you go yourself...?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhh, it's time for me to meet Ninety-Nine! I'm off now! Thanks for your help, Chief!
Hella waves goodbye and runs off, disappearing in a blink of an eye. You sigh and go off to find Garofano with the bundle of clothes in your arms.
Since that day, you haven't visited Garofano. It feels a bit awkward to go see her now.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Long time no see, Chief. How's your injury?
Yet she's still as calm and gentle as when you first met, showing no trace of that merciless Garden assassin.
A master of disguise indeed, you think to yourself.
...I'm all better now.
Hella asked me to bring over these clothes. She would like you to help her mend them.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: All right, just leave them there. I'll take a look after I finish this one.
She nods agreeably. You notice the fabric she's cutting and can't help but inquire.
What are you doing?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: This... is the new shirt I promised to make for you.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You don't have to worry about the size. I have the measurements already. It will definitely fit.
She has the measurements already? Could it be...
You suddenly recall the embrace in the dark alley.
...Garofano, do you take all your targets this seriously?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Hehe... Of course not. You're not just any target to me.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Initially, I did think about eliminating you. But later, I really began to see you as family... as something that belonged to me.
But you started off by lying to me.
Your lies were flawless. Even your emotions were perfectly disguised, fooling even my shackles.
I can't tell whether you're telling the truth anymore.
She stays silent for a moment before answering softly.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...Perhaps, what I said then was the truth.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Like I said, the best type of deception mixes truth with lies. A good lie is one that the liar believes in herself.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: But the reason for my Awakening was real, and so was the loss of my family. To this day, I'm still living in the shadow of losing them.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: That's why I value you so much. I cherish you to the point of disregarding all consequences to eliminate threats against you.
...Your methods are a bit extreme.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Extreme? That's because... I've tasted the consequences of hesitation.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I didn't tell you before, but on the night I lost my family, I had the chance to save my siblings.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: However, when I saw the face of that Corruptor... I couldn't bring myself to do it.
Why?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You wouldn't be able to stab your father who loved and cared for you since childhood without hesitation either, right?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...Unfortunately, I was too weak back then. In the end, I couldn't save anyone.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: After that, I vowed to never make the same mistake again.
Garofano looks at you with that sincere gaze she excels at.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: That's the truth. I hope... you will believe me.
She seems to notice your hesitation and changes the subject with a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I understand that it'd be hard for you to accept me again right away. I don't expect an answer right now.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I should be able to finish this shirt soon. Can you give me your answer when you wear it?
...But I have to go to Syndicate for a mission tomorrow. It'll be a while before I can come back.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: That's all right. I'll wait.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: When you return, I'll... help you try it on myself.
On March XX, Chief ${PlayerName} of the MBCC was severely injured on a mission to Syndicate and fell into a coma.
On April XX, Sinner Garofano escaped from the Bureau and went missing.
